content_zh:
那被称之为小咪的小白虎正趴在门口晒太阳，听到这话后，懒洋洋的抬头看了他一眼。
“我是白虎，你能不能别将我当做小猫一样召唤？”
白小晨立刻不开心了，小手叉腰，小脸垮了下来：“小咪，你身为一只喵，却拒绝承认自己的身份，这已经是你的不对了，现在你连喵喵叫都不会？”
如果小白虎是个人，便能够轻易看到他抽搐的脸。
想它好歹是白虎后裔，成年后就可以威震四方，可这小祖宗却将它成了一只猫，还喂它小鱼干。
它好想吃肉，怎么破？
“小咪，快喊一声喵来听听，喊喵有肉吃。”白小晨不知道从什么地方拿出一块烤肉，在小白虎面前晃悠。
那扑鼻而来的香味让小白虎的口水差点掉了下来，他吞咽了一口，满眼放光。
然后，在美食的诱惑之下，他很没有节操的喊了一声：“喵。”
“这才乖，”白小晨将烤肉丢给了小白虎，拍了拍它的脑袋，“跟着本宝宝，绝对有肉吃！”
小白虎拼命的点头，只要有肉吃，节操又算什么？
白颜眉眼含笑的看着这一人一兽的互动，她的手撑着后脑勺，侧躺在床上，红衣如地毯铺了开来，惊艳绝伦。
这样温馨的画面，她一生，都不会让人来破坏！
如若有人敢抢她儿子！那她倾尽天下，也绝不会放过他！
一抹冷芒从眼内闪过，白颜的身子离开了床榻，三千青丝如瀑般垂直落下，刚刚睡醒的神态间，还带着一丝慵懒。
“走，跟娘亲去和你师公们道别。”
庭院处于岛屿中间，院内一片桃花，粉嫩的花瓣倾洒而下，犹如漫天遍地的花雨。
这样的世外桃源，远离尘世喧闹，安静祥和。
当然，前提是，忽略那轰的一声爆炸之后……
在这爆炸声起之后，白颜的容颜就沉了下来，一旁的白小晨注意到她的脸色，心中感叹又有人要倒霉了……

他快速的跟了上去，抓住白颜的手，天真的双眼内透出幸灾乐祸的笑容。
树林内，除了遍地桃花，还有白颜这些年来所种下的药材，这些药材都是她的心血，如今看到药材化为了一地的废墟，她的心都在滴血。
陡然，白颜扬眸，望向站在面前这几个有些不知所措的老头。
“是谁炼丹失败，炸了我的药材？”
一旁的白小晨跟了一句：“三位师公，坦白从宽，抗拒从严，你们现在最好老实交代。”
“徒儿，这事与我和老二无关，”大师父郑起一脸严肃，正义凛然，痛心疾首，“我和你二师父也是听到了爆炸声才赶来，谁知道老三这混蛋太过分了！先是偷你丹方在先，还擅自尝试炼丹！如今更是炸你药材，我认为，你一定不能放过他！”
二师父任翼也在一旁配合着说道：“没错，宝贝徒儿，我们是来抓赃的，现在老三就交给你处置，任打任骂我们都不会管。”
“你……你们……”三师父丘书容一张老脸涨红，显然被这两个无耻的家伙气的不轻，“以后别说我认识你们！”

content_en:
The little white tiger called Xiaomi was lying at the door basking in the sun. After hearing this, he lazily looked up at him.
"I am White Tiger, can you please stop summoning me like a kitten?"
Bai Xiaochen immediately became unhappy. He put his hands on his hips and his face fell: "Xiao Mi, as a cat, you refuse to acknowledge your identity. This is already your fault. Now you can't even meow?"
If the little white tiger were a human being, you could easily see his twitching face.
I thought it was a descendant of a white tiger and would be powerful when it grew up, but this little ancestor turned it into a cat and fed it small dried fish.
It really wants to eat meat, how to break it?
"Xiao Mi, call me meow and come and listen. Call me meow and you will get meat to eat." Bai Xiaochen took out a piece of barbecue from somewhere and waved it in front of the little white tiger.
The fragrant aroma almost made the little white tiger's mouth drop. He swallowed, his eyes shining.
Then, under the temptation of the delicious food, he shouted without restraint: "Meow."
"That's good." Bai Xiaochen threw the barbecue to the little white tiger and patted it on the head, "Follow me, you will definitely get meat to eat!"
The little white tiger nodded desperately. As long as there is meat to eat, what does moral integrity mean?
Bai Yan looked at the interaction between man and beast with a smile on her face. She supported the back of her head with her hands and lay on her side on the bed. Her red dress was spread out like a carpet, which was stunning.
Such a warm scene will never be destroyed by anyone in her life!
If anyone dares to steal her son! Then she would give him everything in the world and she would never let him go!
A cold light flashed through her eyes, Bai Yan's body left the bed, and three thousand black hair fell vertically like a waterfall. There was still a trace of laziness in her expression as she had just woken up.
"Let's go with mother to say goodbye to your masters."
The courtyard is in the middle of the island. There is a peach blossom in the courtyard, with pink petals pouring down like a rain of flowers all over the sky.
Such a paradise, far away from the hustle and bustle of the world, quiet and peaceful.
Of course, the premise is that after ignoring the loud explosion...
After the explosion, Bai Yan's face darkened. Bai Xiaochen noticed her expression and sighed in his heart that someone was going to be unlucky again...
He quickly followed up and grabbed Bai Yan's hand, with a gloating smile in his innocent eyes.
In the woods, in addition to peach blossoms, there are also medicinal herbs that Bai Yan has planted over the years. These medicinal herbs are all her hard work. Now that she sees the medicinal herbs turned into ruins, her heart is bleeding.
Suddenly, Bai Yan raised her eyes and looked at the somewhat bewildered old men standing in front of her.
"Who failed in refining the alchemy and exploded my medicinal ingredients?"
Bai Xiaochen on the side said: "Three masters, you will be lenient if you confess, and you will be stern if you resist. You'd better tell the truth now."
"Disciple, this matter has nothing to do with me and the second child." Master Zheng Qi looked serious, righteous and heartbroken. "Your second master and I also came after hearing the explosion. Who knew that this bastard, the third child, had gone too far! First he stole your elixir recipe, and then he tried to make it without authorization! Now he is blowing up your medicinal materials. I think you must not let him go!"
The second master Ren Yi also cooperated and said: "Yes, dear disciple, we are here to catch the stolen goods. Now the third child will be left to your disposal. We will not care whether you beat him or scold him."
"You... you..." Third Master Qiu Shurong's old face flushed, obviously very angry at these two shameless guys, "Don't say I know you in the future!"
